name: std::ranges::chunk_by_view<V,Pred>::begin

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: In order to provide the amortized constant-time complexity required by the range concept, this function caches the result within the data member begin_ for use on subsequent calls.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a chunk_by_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Returns an iterator to the first element of the chunk_by_view.
